rows.grounds: adverb of time; qualifies occasional occurrence
present active third plural of sam-bhū
compound in ablative singular indicating causal power

items.question: By whose power do hostile planetary and demonic afflictions sometimes still arise?
items.inference: Occasional afflictions are attributed to mantra-yantra power rather than failure of installation.
uncertainties: Exact scope of vidyāyantra remains context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Sometimes these afflictions occur through the power of mantra and yantra.
